name: Galla
summary: Kiryana store till with a khata (credit) book, part payments and WhatsApp reminder links
about: A corner-shop point of sale for a Pakistani kiryana store. Ring up items from a product grid, put a bill on a customer's khata (udhaar credit book), take part payments and see who owes what and since when, all in PKR. Reminders open WhatsApp with a ready message for the shopkeeper to send; nothing is sent automatically.
how: Open the Till, tap products to add them (they fly into the bill) and change quantities or add a discount.
Pay by Cash to see the change due, or pick a customer and put the bill on Khata or Part pay. The receipt prints out of the slot and coins drop into the galla.
Open the Khata book to see each customer's balance, how many days it is unpaid and how much of the credit limit is used. Filter by 30+ days or Over limit.
Click a customer for the ledger: take a part payment, add udhaar, or tap Remind to open a ready WhatsApp text (wa.me link) in a new tab.
Click the yellow galla in the top bar to count notes at day close; it tells you if the cash is short or over.
Restock products, void or reprint bills, switch the sales chart between 7D, 30D and 12M, and edit the reminder text in Settings.
